findings.summary: A manually detached setsid/double-fork daemon can escape job/descendant observation and later cleanup.
findings.basis: C-D55, SPEC lines 123 and 137, and ADR-0002 sections 4/50 explicitly make cgroup non-required and do not guarantee discovery or retroactive management of every manual daemon. The product must hold observed unknown residue, but cannot claim discovery of a process that has left all approved observation boundaries.

findings.summary: A prior manual_prompt_confirmed flag permits send_user after control FD loss moves the boundary to unknown.
findings.basis: CW-07 requires input to be held when target identity/lifecycle is unknown. Reviewer reproduced PTY write with phase=unknown and unknown_or_manual_residue.

required_followup: Add an independent regression for unknown-state manual input, correct the accepted P2, and delta-review the new candidate.
